title: Hue vs Hoi An: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Hue and Hoi An based on Reddit discussions, real costs, culture, food, and traveler preferences.

categories.title: 🍜 Food & Dining
categories.summary: Hue is Vietnam's royal cuisine capital — bun bo Hue, banh khoai, com hen. Hoi An owns Cao Lau, White Rose dumplings, and Banh Mi Phuong.

categories.title: ⛩️ Cultural Attractions
categories.summary: Hue wins on historical depth: Imperial Citadel, 7 royal tombs, Thien Mu Pagoda. Hoi An's UNESCO Ancient Town wins on visual beauty.

categories.title: 💰 Cost Comparison
categories.summary: Hue is 20-30% cheaper overall. Budget guesthouse: Hue ₫200k-400k vs Hoi An ₫300k-600k/night.

categories.title: ✨ Atmosphere & Vibe
categories.summary: Hue feels like a real Vietnamese city with history. Hoi An is a beautiful, lantern-lit tourist town.

categories.title: 🌤️ Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: February-May is optimal for both. Avoid Hoi An Oct-Nov (severe flooding).

categories.title: 🏨 Where to Stay
categories.summary: Hue offers better value at all price points. Hoi An's riverside villas and An Bang beach retreats are more romantic.

categories.title: 🚌 Getting There & Around
categories.summary: Hue has better transport (airport, train). Hoi An requires flying into Da Nang.

categories.title: 🛍️ Shopping
categories.summary: Hoi An is Vietnam's custom tailoring capital. Hue has Dong Ba Market for local goods.

categories.title: 🧳 Day Trips
categories.summary: Hue: Bach Ma, DMZ, Phong Nha. Hoi An: My Son Sanctuary, Da Nang, countryside cycling.

categories.title: 🎯 Decision Framework
categories.summary: History/budget/food → Hue. Romance/beach/tailoring/atmosphere → Hoi An. Best: do both via Hai Van Pass.

verdict.summary: Hue wins for history, food depth, and authenticity. Hoi An wins for romance, atmosphere, and visual beauty. They're 130km apart — do both. Daily budget: Hue ₫400k-900k ($16-36) vs Hoi An ₫600k-1.3M ($24-52).
takeaways: Choose Hue: History buffs, foodies, budget travelers, authentic Vietnam seekers.
Choose Hoi An: Romantic couples, atmosphere seekers, beach lovers, tailoring shoppers.
Do both: 2 nights Hue + 3 nights Hoi An via the Hai Van Pass is the classic Central Vietnam split.

faqs.question: Is Hue or Hoi An better for first-time Vietnam visitors?
faqs.answer: Do both if possible. Hue for historical depth, Hoi An for visual beauty. They're 130km apart.

faqs.question: How far is Hue from Hoi An?
faqs.answer: ~130km, 3.5-4.5h by bus or 1 scenic day via Hai Van Pass motorbike route.

faqs.question: Which city has better food — Hue or Hoi An?
faqs.answer: Both excellent but different. Hue: bun bo, banh khoai, com hen. Hoi An: Cao Lau, White Rose, Banh Mi Phuong.

faqs.question: How many days in Hue vs Hoi An?
faqs.answer: 2 days in Hue, 2-3 days in Hoi An is the standard recommendation.

faqs.question: Is Hoi An too touristy?
faqs.answer: Yes, more so than Hue. The Ancient Town is crowded year-round. Visit early morning, eat outside Old Town.

faqs.question: What is Hue famous for?
faqs.answer: Imperial Citadel, 7 royal tombs, Thien Mu Pagoda, and royal cuisine.

faqs.question: Can I visit both Hue and Hoi An?
faqs.answer: Yes — the classic Central Vietnam itinerary includes both via Hai Van Pass.

faqs.question: Which city is cheaper?
faqs.answer: Hue — about 20-30% cheaper across accommodation, food, and transport.
